title: Microsoft Purview DLP: upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned upgrade from today's documented managed-app protection, and its dates, licensing and prerequisites are supported. The Purview wizard path is correct but should continue to the user, group and app selectors that determine coverage.

claims.claim: The Purview path through Data loss prevention, Policies and the Enterprise apps and Devices custom wizard reaches Managed cloud apps.
claims.quote: Select Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy. Select Enterprise apps and Devices. Select Custom from the Categories list and then Custom policy from the Regulations list. Accept the default Full directory on the Assign admin units page. Select Managed cloud apps
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path and its rendered copy to 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Enterprise apps and Devices > Categories > Custom > Regulations > Custom policy > Assign admin units > Full directory > Managed cloud apps > Specific users and groups > + Include > Include groups > group > + Include managed apps > app', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-prevent-cloud-sharing-from-edge-biz. The existing path stops before the selectors that set coverage.

claims.claim: Today's setup requires Edge for Business in-browser protection.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether existing managed-app policies migrate automatically or must be recreated for this upgrade.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview upgraded inline protection Entra managed apps default migration licensing grant control. Read browser DLP Learn and managed-app setup. Returned file-policy migration text concerns connected-app data-at-rest policies, not this browser upgrade.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Whether the planned grant control replaces or adds to today's custom session-control setup is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview upgraded inline protection Entra managed apps Conditional Access grant control simulation mode migration default licensing 571397. Read roadmap, browser DLP Learn and Conditional Access session; no replacement or coexistence instructions.

claims.claim: Both the user and the app must be in scope for all prerequisite protections for managed-app DLP to apply.
claims.quote: The user and the app must both be in scope for all the prerequisite protections for the policy to apply to the user in Edge.

claims.claim: A managed-app DLP policy is not applied in Edge until all requirements are met.
claims.quote: The DLP policy won't be applied in Edge until all requirements are met.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview browser data security policies do not apply to B2B guest users.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview browser data security policies don't apply to B2B guest users.

claims.claim: A new policy may not apply to users already signed in until their token expires and they sign in again.
claims.quote: When you add users to policies for the first time, the policy might not be applied right away if they're already signed in to the app. The policy applies after their token expires and they sign in again.

claims.claim: Changing Conditional Access sign-in frequency can shorten the wait for initial policy application.
claims.quote: You can change the sign-in frequency by using conditional access session controls to shorten the wait time.

claims.claim: Managed-app DLP protection might not apply when the user is also in scope for a Defender session policy.
claims.quote: Protections might not apply ... if the user is in scope for both a Microsoft Purview managed cloud app DLP policy and a Microsoft Defender session policy or Microsoft Purview endpoint DLP policy.

claims.claim: Managed-app DLP protection might not apply when the user is also in scope for an Endpoint DLP policy.
claims.quote: You must remove or exclude the users from the Microsoft Defender and the endpoint DLP policies for the managed cloud apps in Edge for Business policy to apply.

claims.claim: No autonomous behaviour is described for this upgrade.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview upgraded inline protection Entra managed apps Conditional Access grant control simulation mode migration default licensing 571397. Read roadmap, browser DLP Learn and managed-app setup; descriptions concern protection of user browser activities, not autonomous agents.

claims.claim: Managed-app block actions apply to users' activities in Edge for Business.
claims.quote: Use the managed-app browser DLP policy scenario to block users from exfiltrating sensitive information from business-managed apps such as ServiceNow and Workday through Microsoft Edge.

claims.claim: Endpoint DLP takes priority over inline Edge DLP when user, context and action match.
claims.quote: Endpoint DLP policies are prioritized over inline DLP policies for cloud apps in Edge for Business if the same user, context, and action are configured in both policies.

claims.claim: The browser DLP Learn page links to Enterprise plans and service description licensing guidance without naming a scenario licence.
claims.quote: For information on licensing, see Microsoft 365 Enterprise Plans; Microsoft 365 Service Descriptions

claims.claim: The preview Protected Clipboard page lists Microsoft 365 E5 or E5 Compliance / E5 Security add-on for its Purview DLP plus session-control scenario.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 E5 (or E5 Compliance / E5 Security add-on) | Purview DLP + MDA session controls (E5)

claims.claim: Today's browser DLP documentation specifies Edge for Business starting with version 158.
claims.quote: These features are available in the two latest stable versions of Edge for Business, starting with version 158.

claims.claim: Today's browser DLP documentation supports the two latest stable Edge for Business versions.
claims.quote: These features are available in the two latest stable versions of Edge for Business, starting with version 158.

claims.claim: Activating managed-app policies requires Conditional Access administration permissions beyond Purview permissions.
claims.quote: To activate policies that apply to managed apps, you need additional permissions for Conditional Access administration

claims.claim: Activating managed-app policies requires permissions for Microsoft Defender Edge in-browser protection.
claims.quote: To activate policies that apply to managed apps, you need additional permissions for Conditional Access administration and Microsoft Defender for Edge In-Browser protection.

claims.claim: Whether the upgrade changes today's prerequisites or roles is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview upgraded inline protection Entra managed apps Conditional Access grant control simulation mode migration default licensing 571397. Read browser DLP Learn permissions and prerequisites, managed-app setup and CA session; none identifies changed upgrade requirements.

claims.claim: Creating Purview DLP policies requires DLP permissions, and Learn links to the deployment page for those permissions.
claims.quote: Permissions to create and deploy Microsoft Purview DLP policies are found here.

claims.claim: Configuring Conditional Access policies requires at least the Conditional Access Administrator role.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as at least a Conditional Access Administrator.

claims.claim: Today's Conditional Access session-control policy is configured in the Microsoft Entra admin center.
claims.quote: Sign into the Microsoft Entra admin center. Create a new Conditional Access policy ... Custom policy must be selected in the session controls dropdown.

claims.claim: Users may see prompts to switch to or create an Edge work profile when accessing protected work resources.
claims.quote: If you try to access the work resource from outside the work profile, you'll be prompted to switch to the work profile or create one if it doesn't exist.

claims.claim: No source states that existing managed-app policies change automatically on arrival of this upgrade.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview upgraded inline protection Entra managed apps default migration licensing grant control. Read roadmap, browser DLP Learn, managed-app setup and Defender in-browser protection; no statement of automatic changes to existing browser policies.
